youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for an overthinking mind.

He: Jesus... I've replayed this morning's meeting in my head all night. 😵‍💫
He: Looking for the exact sentence I said wrong. It's 1am. The court in my head is still open.
Jesus: Replaying isn't preparing. It's punishing, and the verdict never comes, so the trial never ends.
He: But if I don't rehearse, I'll repeat it tomorrow.
Jesus: Tomorrow deserves one run-through. Not twelve.
Jesus: Put today down. You can pick it up lighter in the morning.
Jesus: What do you replay at night? 👇

“Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.”
Matthew 6:34 (BSB)
